description: AFM Kamal Chowdhury and colleagues publish PowNet-Thailand v1.3, a network-constrained unit-commitment and economic-dispatch case for the Thai power system. Zenodo provides the 2016 configuration, sample inputs and outputs, Python setup and solver scripts, and 1976–2005 climate-dependent inputs under an MIT licence. The network represents plants, substations, high-voltage lines, domestic load and exports, including supply from Laos. A modeller can rerun a selected year by changing the setup year and calling the solver, then compare dispatch under alternative hydropower budgets. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Thai implementation of PowNet. A limitation is that the infrastructure and demand baseline is 2016 and the historical climate cases are not a current operational forecast. The public page links separate PowNet instructions; the 71 MB archive was not downloaded, so input completeness and solver results were not independently checked.
